comparison.objective: Refit and secure a bicycle quick-release front wheel.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual wheel alignment into two dropout slots and over-center lever closure.
comparison.success_condition: Both axle ends fully seated and lever closed in a safe direction; closing before seating fails.
comparison.reason: Shares alignment, seating and final locking, but tests assembly retention rather than adjusting a continuous setting from observed dynamic response. No separate spec versions were present; the body supplied the rubric.
